svg.title: UCC AI Quest 2023 — vegetation segmentation pipeline and model
svg.desc: Input drone images and annotations flow through data pre-processing (augmentation and normalization), then model training with validation, then model testing. The augmentation callout lists random crop, JPEG compression, shift-scale-rotate, flipping, hue-saturation-value, and Gaussian blur. The model is DeepLabV3 with a ResNet101 backbone, with learning-rate scheduler, JPEG compression, customized normalization values, and a learning-rate and batch-size finder as important add-ons. Other explorations include U-Net and FCN backbones, batch sizes 8/16/32, Adam and AdamW optimizers, and 224×224 resizing.
